name: automate-server-node-adapter
description: Node.js is no longer used to run this service (see README.md — it's FastAPI/Python now). This package.json exists ONLY for bakeoff/adapters/stagehandAdapter.mjs, which needs the Stagehand SDK — a Node-only library with no Python equivalent — invoked as a subprocess from bakeoff/run_bakeoff.py under a Node >=22 binary (see bakeoff/lib/resolve_runtime.py).
